stem: Which entries belong in a reproducible morphology baseline before diagnosis? Select all that apply.
choices: Plant or crop identifier and date
Observed node, internode, branching, leaf, and reproductive features
Chronological age if known, recorded separately from morphological stage
A confirmed causal diagnosis even when no supporting measurements have been collected
Uncertainty notes for structures that cannot yet be classified confidently
rationale: A reproducible baseline records identity, time, direct morphology, chronology, and uncertainty. A causal diagnosis should not be inserted as a confirmed observation when evidence is incomplete.
